desktop_reference.hero_h1: Human collaboration at the speed of AI

known_differences: The animated Miro hero canvas is approximated with static CSS timeline UI; no identical official reusable hero asset was found in the captured page assets.
The customer wordmarks are text approximations; the live page uses branded logos.
The generated Stitch screens invented several customer and feature details, so the public draft uses source-backed copy and captured official imagery instead.
Roadmaps, Diagrams and Workshops tab destinations link to official Miro pages because their dynamic tab content was not captured.
The current official mobile layout and the rendered desktop/mobile draft have not passed side-by-side visual comparison; no pixel-perfect claim is made.
